title: SPREP Pacific Climate Change Portal
description: SPREP-hosted portal of Pacific climate change projects, data and country resources.
notes: Regional climate knowledge hub. Hosts third-party material with mixed rights; no single portal-wide licence confirmed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Climate Change Science and Adaptation Planning (PCCSP) Climate Projections
description: Country-level climate projections and observed trends for Pacific partner countries.
notes: Authoritative projection set for Pacific adaptation planning. Australian Government copyright; reuse terms not confirmed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: Pacific Sea Level and Geodetic Monitoring (SEAFRAME) Tide Gauge Network
description: Hourly and monthly sea level, air/water temperature and pressure from SEAFRAME stations across Pacific Island countries.
notes: Long-running Pacific sea level record; complements the existing /pacific sea level endpoint. Reuse terms not confirmed. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: WMO OSCAR/Surface — Pacific Observing Station Metadata
description: WMO station registry metadata for Pacific Island synoptic and climate stations.
notes: Station metadata layer for WMO Pacific station data. WMO data policy (Resolution 1) governs exchange, not commercial resale. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.

title: NOAA Oceanic Niño Index (ONI)
description: Three-month running mean SST anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region, the operational ENSO index.
notes: US federal government work (public domain). Control case for a CLEAR licence path; already wrapped by the /pacific ENSO endpoint. URL not live-verified at authoring (sandbox had no outbound network) — confirm before a live run.
